entities.name: PMID:27493727
observations: Cancer Metabolism (2016) study reports that in K562 leukemia cells, PC-derived oxaloacetate undergoes ROS-induced decarboxylation to malonate; malonate inhibits SDH and fumarate was reduced approximately twofold after BaP treatment.
This is a reported ROS-mediated metabolite formation mechanism; malonate is not itself a ROS molecule.

entities.name: Malonate
observations: Dicarboxylate metabolite reported as a product of ROS-induced oxaloacetate decarboxylation in leukemia cells; inhibits succinate dehydrogenase. It is not itself a reactive oxygen species.

entities.name: Pyruvate carboxylase
observations: In K562 leukemia cells, PC activity was reported to supply oxaloacetate for ROS-induced decarboxylation to malonate.

entities.name: PC-ROS malonate pathway
observations: A 2016 K562-cell study reports PC-derived oxaloacetate fuels ROS-induced decarboxylation to malonate; malonate inhibits SDH and fumarate fell approximately twofold after bezafibrate/medroxyprogesterone treatment. The study supports malonate as a ROS-mediated product, not as a ROS species.
